summary: Held through an early -4pt dip and a strong favorable run to +40pts (giveback 0%, ER10 0.89), which looked like the thesis working. Bailed at frame 8 (t=8m) when price fully round-tripped back through breakeven to -12.25pts, giveback hit 40%, and ER10 collapsed to 0.19 with HA-against firing -- that combination (full retrace of a large favorable excursion plus collapsing trend efficiency) read as a genuine reversal, not a normal dip. Next time: watch giveback-from-peak and ER10 together as the pair that separates a real pullback from a round-trip reversal, rather than reacting to raw px sign alone.
